text:
riya: CI onboarding failed for sampleapp v2. The Python SDK returned a different deployment payload than our REST docs expect (parity + param name drift).

dan: what broke specifically?

riya: sampleapp calls sdk.deploy(...) and then checks `deployment['autoscale']` and `deployment['visibility']`. SDK returns `{'id':'d_1','scale':2,'is_public':False}` (no autoscale object, camel vs snake names). sampleapp crashed on KeyError/TypeError.

oliver: we simplified the Python surface early on to a flat `scale` int and `is_public` boolean. didn't anticipate template code checking nested autoscale or visibility string.

tay: another angle: onboarding webhook hit duplicated operations because REST 429 returned Retry-After: 8 but SDK retried immediately due to legacy retryer. infra spiked a few duplicate deploys.

ci-bot: Build #2103 failed (2026-03-28T11:03Z) - sampleapp/onboard. See logs: https://ci.internal/builds/2103

dan: mitigation plan?

riya: quick fixes proposed:
  1) SDK patch: on deploy/patch calls, serialize `scale` -> `autoscale: {min: scale, max: scale}` and include `concurrency_limit` alongside `max_concurrency` (emit both keys). Non-breaking.
  2) Response parity: include `visibility` ("public"/"private") derived from `is_public` and keep both keys for a 3-month shim.
  3) Retryer: honor `Retry-After` header by default and expose `respect_retry_after` toggle.

oliver: I can land a small patch for (1) and (2) today as a patch release. (3) needs tests and a minor bump; target tomorrow.

dan: docs/sampleapp: relax checks to accept either `visibility` string or `is_public` bool and accept `autoscale` object or `scale` int. Add unit tests for both shapes.

tay: also recommend adding a short migration snippet to the changelog showing mappings, e.g. `is_public -> visibility: public|private` and `scale -> autoscale`. Customers copy templates.

riya: created tickets: SDK-802 (serialize autoscale + dual keys), SDK-803 (response parity shim), SDK-804 (retry-after support), DOCS-502 (sampleapp validation + migration snippet).

dan: thanks. once patch is published tag this thread and I'll rerun CI.

oliver: will publish beta in ~2h and ping here.
